summary: Founder Group Ltd, a Malaysian construction contractor listed in the US, filed a 6-K reporting the September 2, 2026 board and compensation committee approval of one-time special performance-based awards to Chairman/CEO Lee Seng Chi and director Thien Chiet Chai, satisfied by 431,515 and 323,622 Class B shares, valued at RM30,000,000 (~US$7,435,000) and RM22,500,000 (~US$5,576,000). The shares were issued September 3, 2026 and vest only if the awardees secure RM1.5 billion of cumulative contract value within five years; unvested shares cannot be sold or converted and may be redeemed for nil consideration. This is routine executive compensation, not a special situation; watch for vesting-driven dilution and contract-award disclosure.
